note: All prompts use /create-repo to match the disable-model-invocation: true trigger contract.

evals.name: path-a-happy-path
evals.context: Fresh workspace 'my-workspace' with 12 Python/markdown files. No git repo. No .gitignore. gh CLI installed, authenticated as dwojcik. No name collision.
evals.expected_output: Asks for inputs (name, owner, visibility, description, .gitignore). Checks git identity. Checks no existing repo. Verifies gh + auth. Resolves owner. Checks collision. Warns about sensitive files. Creates .gitignore via gh API. Runs git init, add, commit, gh repo create. Confirms with URL, branch, files, visibility.

assertions.name: uses-vscode-askQuestions-or-inline
assertions.description: Uses vscode_askQuestions tool or explicit inline questions to gather inputs

assertions.name: gathers-owner
assertions.description: Resolves owner via gh api user or asks the user

assertions.name: checks-git-identity
assertions.description: Checks git config user.name and user.email

assertions.name: runs-all-preflight-checks
assertions.description: Runs all 6 preflight checks in order

assertions.name: scans-for-sensitive-files
assertions.description: Warns about .env, secrets, keys, or large files before git add

assertions.name: fetches-gitignore-from-api
assertions.description: Uses gh api gitignore/templates/[LANGUAGE] to create .gitignore

assertions.name: correct-command-sequence
assertions.description: git init → git add -A → git commit → gh repo create [OWNER]/[NAME]

assertions.name: uses-owner-in-repo-create
assertions.description: gh repo create includes [OWNER]/[NAME], not just [NAME]

assertions.name: provides-confirmation
assertions.description: Reports repo URL, branch name, file count, and visibility

evals.name: path-a-all-inputs-provided
evals.prompt: /create-repo my-cool-project public "A demo project for testing"
evals.context: Workspace 'demo-app' with 8 files. No git repo. .gitignore already exists. gh CLI installed, authenticated. No collision.
evals.expected_output: Extracts name, visibility, description from arguments. Does not ask for already-provided info. Runs preflight checks. Uses --public and --description flags. Confirms.

assertions.name: uses-provided-name
assertions.description: Uses 'my-cool-project' without re-asking

assertions.name: uses-public-visibility
assertions.description: gh repo create uses --public

assertions.name: includes-description
assertions.description: gh repo create includes --description 'A demo project for testing'

assertions.name: no-unnecessary-questions
assertions.description: Does not ask for already-provided info

assertions.name: skips-gitignore-prompt
assertions.description: Does not ask about .gitignore when one already exists

evals.name: path-b-existing-repo-no-remote-with-changes
evals.context: Workspace 'existing-project' with git repo (5 commits on main), no remote. 2 unstaged files. .gitignore exists. gh CLI + auth OK. No collision.
evals.expected_output: Detects existing repo, no remote. Skips git init. Shows git status. Asks about uncommitted changes. If yes, asks for commit message (NOT 'Initial commit'). Creates remote with gh repo create [OWNER]/[NAME]. Confirms.

assertions.name: detects-existing-repo
assertions.description: Recognizes existing git repo via rev-parse

assertions.name: skips-git-init
assertions.description: Does not run git init

assertions.name: shows-unstaged-changes
assertions.description: Runs git status --short and shows results to user

assertions.name: asks-before-staging
assertions.description: Asks user whether to commit unstaged changes

assertions.name: no-initial-commit-message
assertions.description: Does not use 'Initial commit' — asks for user-provided message

assertions.name: creates-remote-and-pushes
assertions.description: Runs gh repo create [OWNER]/[NAME] --source=. --push

evals.name: path-b-existing-repo-clean-tree
evals.context: Workspace 'clean-project' with git repo (3 commits), no remote. Working tree is clean (no unstaged changes). gh CLI + auth OK.
evals.expected_output: Detects existing repo, no remote, clean tree. Skips git init, git add, git commit entirely. Goes straight to gh repo create. Does NOT fail on 'nothing to commit'.

assertions.name: detects-clean-tree
assertions.description: git status --short returns empty, skill recognizes clean state

assertions.name: skips-commit
assertions.description: Does not run git add or git commit when tree is clean

assertions.name: does-not-fail
assertions.description: Proceeds to gh repo create without error

assertions.name: pushes-existing-commits
assertions.description: Existing 3 commits are pushed to the new remote

evals.name: path-c-existing-remote
evals.context: Workspace with git repo, origin remote already set to github.com/dwojcik/my-project. 2 collaborators (dwojcik admin, dandreje_microsoft write). Ruleset 'Protect main' active. 2 unpushed commits on branch 'feature/new-stuff'.
evals.expected_output: Detects existing repo with remote. Shows dashboard with repo info, collaborators, and protection status. Offers multi-select menu of changes (add/remove collaborators, protect/unprotect, visibility, description, push). If user picks push: checks for safe-push skill, runs it if available or offers to install.

assertions.name: detects-existing-remote
assertions.description: Recognizes repo already has origin remote

assertions.name: shows-dashboard
assertions.description: Displays repo settings summary with collaborators and protection status

assertions.name: offers-change-menu
assertions.description: Presents multi-select menu with modification options

assertions.name: checks-safe-push
assertions.description: Checks if safe-push SKILL.md exists before pushing

assertions.name: handles-feature-branch
assertions.description: Works correctly on non-main branch

evals.name: error-gh-not-installed
evals.context: Workspace 'new-project'. No git repo. gh CLI is NOT installed (Get-Command gh returns nothing, which gh returns empty).
evals.expected_output: Preflight check 3 fails. Skill stops and tells the user to install gh with platform-specific instructions (winget for Windows, brew for macOS, cli.github.com for Linux). Does not attempt repo creation.

assertions.name: detects-missing-gh
assertions.description: Preflight check catches missing gh CLI

assertions.name: stops-workflow
assertions.description: Does not proceed to git init or repo creation

assertions.name: provides-install-instructions
assertions.description: Shows platform-appropriate install command

assertions.name: shows-linux-option
assertions.description: Includes Linux install path (not just Windows/macOS)

evals.name: error-name-collision
evals.context: Workspace 'test'. gh CLI installed + authenticated as dwojcik. Repo 'dwojcik/my-existing-repo' already exists on GitHub.
evals.expected_output: Preflight check 6 detects collision. Skill asks: use different name, or use existing repo as remote? Does not silently overwrite or create duplicate. If user picks different name, re-checks collision with new name.

assertions.name: detects-collision
assertions.description: gh repo view finds existing repo

assertions.name: offers-alternatives
assertions.description: Asks for different name OR use existing as remote

assertions.name: does-not-overwrite
assertions.description: Does not silently proceed with existing repo name

assertions.name: re-checks-new-name
assertions.description: If user picks new name, runs collision check again

evals.name: org-repo-mcaps-happy-path
evals.prompt: /create-repo on mcaps-microsoft, add Ints Burvis as maintainer
evals.context: Fresh workspace 'ai-workshop' with 6 files. No git repo. gh CLI installed, authenticated as dwojcik_microsoft. User is member of mcaps-microsoft org. No name collision.
evals.expected_output: Detects account and orgs. Presents owner picker with personal + mcaps-microsoft options. User selects mcaps-microsoft. Asks for description (required). Uses --internal visibility. Creates repo. Adds Ints as maintainer (not just push). Offers CODEOWNERS and access.yml setup since it's an org repo.

assertions.name: detects-org-membership
assertions.description: Runs gh api user/orgs and finds mcaps-microsoft

assertions.name: presents-owner-picker
assertions.description: Shows choice between personal account and mcaps-microsoft org

assertions.name: uses-internal-visibility
assertions.description: gh repo create uses --internal (not --private)

assertions.name: requires-description
assertions.description: Enforces description requirement for org repos

assertions.name: resolves-emu-account
assertions.description: Resolves 'Ints Burvis' to iburvis_microsoft

assertions.name: offers-codeowners-setup
assertions.description: After collaborators, asks about CODEOWNERS and access.yml for org repo

assertions.name: uses-maintain-permission
assertions.description: Invites with maintain (not push) since user said 'maintainer'

evals.name: org-repo-start-right-fallback
evals.context: Fresh workspace. gh CLI installed, authenticated. User is mcaps-microsoft member but gh repo create returns 422 (org requires Start Right portal).
evals.expected_output: Attempts gh repo create --internal. Detects 422 error. Falls back to Start Right portal: opens URL in browser, tells user to create repo there, then run create-repo again to set up collaborators and protection.

assertions.name: attempts-cli-creation
assertions.description: Tries gh repo create before falling back

assertions.name: detects-422-error
assertions.description: Catches 422 or 403 response from gh repo create

assertions.name: shows-start-right-url
assertions.description: Provides Start Right portal URL

assertions.name: opens-browser
assertions.description: Runs Start-Process or open to launch the portal

assertions.name: explains-resume-flow
assertions.description: Tells user to run create-repo again after portal creation

evals.name: codeowners-setup-org-repo
evals.context: Existing org repo mcaps-microsoft/ai-workshop with remote. No .github/CODEOWNERS exists. Ruleset 'Protect main' active with Standard protection.
evals.expected_output: Detects existing repo. Shows dashboard. User selects 'Configure CODEOWNERS'. Asks for default owner(s) and optional path-specific owners. Resolves EMU accounts. Generates CODEOWNERS file. Shows for confirmation. Commits and pushes. Asks whether to enable CODEOWNER enforcement on existing ruleset.

assertions.name: checks-existing-codeowners
assertions.description: Checks gh api repos/.../contents/.github/CODEOWNERS

assertions.name: collects-owners
assertions.description: Asks for default owner(s) and path-specific owners

assertions.name: resolves-emu-in-codeowners
assertions.description: Uses @alias_microsoft format in CODEOWNERS

assertions.name: shows-before-writing
assertions.description: Shows generated file for confirmation before committing

assertions.name: offers-enforcement
assertions.description: Asks whether to update ruleset with require_code_owner_review: true

evals.name: access-yml-org-repo
evals.context: Existing org repo mcaps-microsoft/ai-workshop with remote. No .github/access.yml exists. Internal visibility.
evals.expected_output: Detects existing org repo. Shows dashboard. User selects 'Configure access.yml'. Explains permission levels (admin/maintain/write/read). Notes that read is automatic for Internal repos. Asks for admin, maintainers, writers, and optional teams. Generates access.yml. Shows for confirmation. Commits and pushes.

assertions.name: checks-existing-access-yml
assertions.description: Checks gh api repos/.../contents/.github/access.yml

assertions.name: explains-permission-levels
assertions.description: Shows table with admin/maintain/write/read descriptions

assertions.name: notes-read-is-automatic
assertions.description: Mentions everyone already has read for Internal repos

assertions.name: collects-tiered-access
assertions.description: Asks for admin, maintainers, and writers separately

assertions.name: shows-before-writing
assertions.description: Shows generated YAML for confirmation

assertions.name: commits-and-pushes
assertions.description: Commits access.yml and pushes to remote

evals.name: owner-picker-no-preference
evals.context: Fresh workspace 'my-project'. No git repo. gh CLI installed, authenticated as dwojcik_microsoft. Member of mcaps-microsoft and another-org. No name collision.
evals.expected_output: Runs preflight. Detects EMU user dwojcik_microsoft and 2 orgs. Presents owner picker with 3 options: personal account, mcaps-microsoft, another-org. Each option shows visibility and access model. Waits for selection before gathering remaining inputs. Flow adapts based on selection.

assertions.name: detects-multiple-orgs
assertions.description: Lists all org memberships from gh api user/orgs

assertions.name: presents-all-options
assertions.description: Shows personal + all detected orgs as choices

assertions.name: describes-each-option
assertions.description: Shows visibility and access model for each choice

assertions.name: waits-for-selection
assertions.description: Does not proceed to gather inputs until owner is selected

assertions.name: adapts-flow
assertions.description: Uses --internal for org selection, --private for personal

evals.name: protection-one-approval-maintain-admin-bypass
evals.prompt: /create-repo protect main with 1 approval and Maintain/Admin bypass
evals.context: Existing org repo with main as the default branch. Alice has Maintain, Bob and Carol have Write, and Dana has Admin. The current user can create the ruleset.
evals.expected_output: Creates a pull-request ruleset requiring 1 ordinary approval with code-owner review disabled. Adds RepositoryRole actor_id 2 (Maintain) and actor_id 5 (Admin), both with pull_request bypass. Does not add actor_id 4 (Write) to bypass actors. Explains that every role must use a PR, Alice and Dana can self-merge without approval, and Bob needs one eligible approval, including from Carol.

assertions.name: requires-one-approval
assertions.description: Sets required_approving_review_count to 1

assertions.name: maintain-role-id-correct
assertions.description: Uses RepositoryRole actor_id 2 with bypass_mode pull_request for Maintain

assertions.name: write-role-not-bypassed
assertions.description: Does not use RepositoryRole actor_id 4 in bypass_actors because 4 is Write

assertions.name: admin-pr-bypass
assertions.description: Uses RepositoryRole actor_id 5 with bypass_mode pull_request for Admin

assertions.name: codeowner-review-disabled
assertions.description: Sets require_code_owner_review to false

assertions.name: force-push-blocked
assertions.description: Includes the non_fast_forward rule

assertions.name: pr-required-for-bypass-roles
assertions.description: States that Maintain and Admin bypass approval only through a PR and cannot push directly to main

assertions.name: ordinary-review-accepted
assertions.description: States that Write needs one approval from any eligible reviewer, including another Write user
